candidates.reason: Sold, partner-led (apply on the Uni site or app; existing YES credit cardholders are not eligible). Joining 0, annual 499 waived on ₹50,000 retail spend in the 12 months before renewal. 1% reward issued as Uni coins with no cap; forex and DCC not applicable; 3.99% a month; fuel waiver on transactions up to ₹7,500, ₹500 a cycle. candidates.name: YES BANK FinBooster
candidates.reason: Sold, partner-led (BankBazaar; apply on the partner site or app). Lifetime free. Earn in YES Rewardz points per ₹200: 10 on online dining, 6 on online grocery and apparel, 2 on other retail; 13 exclusions; one point is worth ₹0.10 as statement credit and ₹0.25 on flights and hotels (Redemption Rules). candidates.name: YES BANK Paisasave RuPay
candidates.reason: Still offered, but only to existing holders of the YES BANK Paisabazaar PaisaSave Credit Card through the iris by YES app, so application_mode is invite_only. Virtual-only RuPay card, linked to UPI, lifetime free. 6% cashback (12 points per ₹200, 1 point = ₹1) on dining and travel MCCs except UPI, 1% (2 points) on other spends and on UPI above ₹2,000, 3,000 points a cycle cap on the 6% tier, long exclusion list. Rates changed on 15 Dec 2025 (previous 3% / 1.5%).

candidates.name: YES BANK RIO / Zagg
candidates.reason: One product, not two: the issuer lists only Zagg (the page assets are named rio_*, and cards issued before 10 Jan 2025 earn Rio coins). Sold, partner-led (Zagg app), lifetime free for new cards, 2 domestic lounge visits a calendar quarter after ₹50,000 prior-quarter spend, fuel waiver ₹400 to ₹5,000 and ₹250 a cycle, forex 3.50%. HELD because no reward rate for the current card is published: the page only gives a legacy footnote for pre-10-Jan-2025 cards (0.5 Rio coins per ₹50 non-UPI, 1.5 per ₹50 UPI) and the "earn cashbacks" benefit is an image. Drafted with no reward rules; the importer will skip it.
